critical_flags.detail: A Basel departure on July 14, the Strasbourg document date July 17, and an editorial note describing eight days of discussion cannot be flattened into one completed eight-day stay ending July 17. The 19 July letter indicates the envoys remained in Strasbourg; inspect the original clauses, possible dating contexts and the chronology before assigning a return date.
1537-08-02 occurs in witness C and later witness E; 1988 editor rejects it. Keep manuscript inscription, Barge-style year emendation, and 1988 editorial dating 1536-07-17 as separate fields.
1886 letter 297 starts at printed p.421 and another letter starts p.422. Confirm exact paragraph and letter break from facsimile.
The 1886 Brieffer print and the 1937 WA citation are the same historical letter; Myconius 19 July is another historical letter only indirectly quoted in this iteration.
Witness B/D/E folio and shelfmark strings require print-page image comparison; do not normalize doubtful OCR digits as confirmed identifiers.
